description: This file contains cryptographic prime number generation and primality testing functions, including Miller-Rabin tests, trial division, and prime generation routines for RSA and DH key sizes, with specific focus on cryptographic security parameters.

methods.name: BN_prime_checks_for_size
methods.description: Returns the number of Miller-Rabin iterations needed for a given prime size in bits, based on security standards.

methods.name: num_trial_division_primes
methods.description: Determines how many small primes to test with trial division based on the size of the number.

methods.name: BN_PRIME_CHECKS_BLINDED
methods.description: Constant defining the number of iterations for blinding in the primality test to prevent timing attacks.

methods.name: probable_prime
methods.description: Generates a probable prime of specified bit length, avoiding obvious composites.

methods.name: probable_prime_dh
methods.description: Generates a probable prime suitable for Diffie-Hellman parameters, with additional constraints.

methods.name: probable_prime_dh_safe
methods.description: Generates a safe prime for Diffie-Hellman, ensuring (p-1)/2 is also prime.
